desc:
If you read this, you should join immediately.
Welcome to Realistic Hockey (5 on 5)! 

⚠️ This is a brand new game, we are actively working on adding new updates and fixing bugs that may occur.

UPDATES:
🎉NEW CELEBRATIONS!
🏟️ 7 NEW STADIUMS!
🛠️ Fixed puck suddenly stopping after shooting!
🕒 Overtime period has been set to 3 minutes.
🏒 Added new right/left quick dekes!

📱 🎮 The game has been made very simple for mobile and console users!
🌟 VIP SERVERS ARE FREE AND OWNERS HAVE ACCESS TO FULL ADMIN PANEL!

Join the league now (must be 13+): https://www.roblox.com/groups/34059829/Realistic-Hockey-League

INFO:
🧍‍♂️ Realistic characters & animations.
🕒 Fast-paced gameplay in a full size hockey rink.
⭐ Progress is saved!

CONTROLS (PC):
E - Check
Q - Dangle
Spacebar - One-timer slapshot
CTRL - View lock
Left Click - Shoot/Poke

🔨 Developed by V_ersalty
